svg.title: Everfolk skill-tree design: 65 capabilities in a left-to-right prerequisite DAG
svg.desc: Four fully specified families and eight ten-depth specialization paths. Careers are outcomes in node details. Four additional future branches remain visible as Unavailable roadmap entries. Nodes link to their exact rules in the read-only viewer.
